# Viz 1

```{r}
#| fig-width: 11
#| fig-height: 6
#| fig-alt: "A line graph shows simulated workout session durations from September 1 to October 25, 2026. Five colored lines represent push, pull, shoulders, legs, and cardio. Points mark individual sessions. Leg sessions last longest, while cardio duration varies most."

library(tidyverse)

# Load the detailed dataset
workout_details <- read_csv("workout_details.csv")

workout_details$date <- as.Date(workout_details$date)

# Put tennis in the Cardio category
workout_details$workout[
  workout_details$exercise == "Tennis"
] <- "Cardio"

# Keep one row per session
workouts <- workout_details %>%
  distinct(date, workout, session_duration_min)

# Create one graph with five lines
line_plot <- ggplot(
  workouts,
  aes(
    x = date,
    y = session_duration_min,
    color = workout,
    group = workout
  )
) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Push" = "#D55E00",
      "Pull" = "#0072B2",
      "Shoulders" = "#007A5E",
      "Legs" = "#444444",
      "Cardio" = "#882255"
    )
  ) +
  scale_x_date(
    date_breaks = "1 week",
    date_labels = "%b %d"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(40, 80),
    breaks = seq(40, 80, 10)
  ) +
  labs(
  title = "Leg workouts lasted longest; cardio varied most",
  subtitle = paste(
    "Total workout duration by session date and workout type.",
    "September 1–October 25, 2026 | Cardio sessions are tennis.",
    sep = "\n"
  ),
  x = "Workout date",
  y = "Total session duration (minutes)",
  color = "Workout type",
  caption = paste(
    "Joseph Saputra | September–October 2026",
    "Source: Simulated workout log.",
    "Lines connect recorded sessions of the same type; workouts were not recorded every day.",
    sep = "\n"
  )
) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0, size = 10)
  )

line_plot
```

















```{r}

#| fig-width: 11
#| fig-height: 6.5
#| fig-alt: "A line graph of simulated workout durations from September 1 to October 25, 2026. Leg workouts last around 70 minutes. Cardio varies most, between approximately 45 and 60 minutes. Other workout types remain relatively stable, with no clear overall upward or downward trend."

library(tidyverse)

# Load the data
workout_details <- read_csv("workout_details.csv")

workout_details$date <- as.Date(workout_details$date)

# Put tennis in the Cardio category
workout_details$workout[
  workout_details$exercise == "Tennis"
] <- "Cardio"

# Keep one row per workout session
workouts <- workout_details %>%
  distinct(date, workout, session_duration_min)

ggplot(
  workouts,
  aes(
    x = date,
    y = session_duration_min,
    color = workout,
    group = workout
  )
) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(
    aes(shape = workout),
    size = 3
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Push" = "#D55E00",
      "Pull" = "#0072B2",
      "Shoulders" = "#007A5E",
      "Legs" = "#444444",
      "Cardio" = "#882255"
    )
  ) +
  scale_x_date(
    breaks = as.Date(c(
      "2026-09-01",
      "2026-09-15",
      "2026-09-29",
      "2026-10-13",
      "2026-10-25"
    )),
    date_labels = "%b %d"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(40, 80),
    breaks = seq(40, 80, 10)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Leg workouts lasted longest; cardio varied most",
    subtitle = paste(
      "Each point represents the total duration of one workout session.",
      "September 1–October 25, 2026 | Cardio sessions are tennis.",
      sep = "\n"
    ),
    x = "Workout date",
    y = "Total session duration (minutes)",
    color = "Workout type",
    shape = "Workout type",
    caption = paste(
      "Joseph Saputra | September–October 2026",
      "Source: Simulated workout log.",
      "Lines connect recorded sessions of the same type; gaps do not represent daily workouts.",
      sep = "\n",
      ""
    )
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 18
    ),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(
      size = 12,
      margin = margin(b = 15)
    ),
    plot.caption = element_text(
      color = "gray45",
      hjust = 0,
      size = 10,
      margin = margin(t = 12)
    )
  )

```

The main pattern is a difference between workout types. In this simulated log, leg workouts lasted longest, at around 70 minutes, although only three leg sessions were recorded. Cardio had the largest variation in duration, while push, pull, and shoulder sessions stayed relatively consistent. There was no clear overall increase or decrease from September to October. This suggests that session duration differed more by workout type than by time during this period.
